description: This is a shell script primarily used for testing Git merge operations, including various merge scenarios, options parsing, conflict handling, and related functionalities typically used in the Git project test suite.

methods.name: create_merge_msgs
methods.description: Creates predefined merge message files for use in testing various merge scenarios.

methods.name: verify_merge
methods.description: Verifies that a merge produced the expected results, including commit message and commit hash if applicable.

methods.name: verify_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD matches the expected commit hash.

methods.name: verify_parents
methods.description: Verifies the parent commits of the current HEAD match expected commits.

methods.name: verify_mergeheads
methods.description: Checks the MERGE_HEAD references for expected merge sources.

methods.name: verify_no_mergehead
methods.description: Confirms that there is no active merge in progress (no MERGE_HEAD).
